segments.text: Let us start with your childhood. Where did you grow up?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01

segments.text: Um, I grew up by the sea. We lived in a little house near the harbour.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In the winter my father split the firewood for us.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: My mother made the best noodles. Every summer she cooked them out in the yard.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In 1962 I moved to the city and worked in a factory. That is where I met my husband.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
